List approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) with the indication 'COVID-19'. Return the following columns: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
